newsitem.title: USA: CNF logistics unit wins Imation contract.
newsitem.headline: CNF logistics unit wins Imation contract.

text.p: Consolidated Freightways Inc (CNF) said Tuesday its Menlo Logistics unit has been picked to provide distrubtion in North America, Australia and New Zealand for Imation Corp.
The company did not have an estimated contract value.

Menlo will handle all distrubtion for Imation, including the delivery of raw materials to manufacturing plants and the shipping of finished goods, as well as warehousing, inventory and some packaging, said CNF spokesman Mark Nelson.

Menlo provides more than 90 percent of the revenues generated by CNF's smallest business unit, which produced about $300 million in pro forma revenues for the first three quarters 1996, said CNF spokesman Patrick Fossenier.

CNF's other businesses include Con-Way Transportation Services, its regional trucking unit, and Emery Worldwide, its air freight unit. CNF pro forma revenues for the first three quarters of 1996 were $2.7 billion, Fossenier said.
